basic_details.job_title: CSKHPKV Field cum Lab Helper Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: CSK Himachal Pradesh Krishi Vishvavidyalaya (CSKHPKV), Palampur, has invited applications for the post of Field-cum-Lab Helper under Advt No. Fellowship Notice No. 08/2026. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 7 November 2026.

qualification.details: Qualification: Matriculation | Desirable: | Experience only be considered in Crop Management and Field data handling

how_to_apply: Applications are invited on plain paper from eligible candidates.
Attach bank draft of the appropriate amount of processing fee in favour of the Comptroller, CSKHPKV, Palampur.
Reach the office of The Head, Department of Agricultural Biotechnology, COA, CSKHPKV, Palampur H.P.
Make sure it reaches by 7 November 2026.
important_instructions: Project: Enhancing Climate-Resilient Crops through Pre-Breeding, Crop Modeling and Agro-Ecological Farmers' Practices under Consumption of Resilient Orphan Products for Healthier Diets Phase II (CROPS4HD), Bioversity International

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 7 November 2026 Vacancies: 1 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Fee: General Categories: Rs. 450; Reserved categories: Rs. 110 Pay: Rs. 20,000 per month Place: Palampur
